items.exampleEn: The clothes for the trip were laid out on the bed.
items.exampleZh: 旅行要穿的衣服都擺在床上了。

items.exampleEn: Let's stop worrying about the past and look ahead.
items.exampleZh: 我們別再為過去煩惱，往前看吧。

items.exampleEn: They've already marked these televisions down.
Some shops mark their prices up before a big sale.
items.exampleZh: 有些商店會在大拍賣前先把價格調高。

items.exampleEn: She almost passed out with joy when she heard she had won.
items.exampleZh: 她聽到自己贏了，高興得差點昏倒。

items.exampleEn: He is very successful, but he always plays it down.
items.exampleZh: 他非常成功，但總是輕描淡寫地帶過。

items.exampleEn: Volunteers put in extra time on weekends to clean the park.
items.exampleZh: 志工們週末投入額外的時間打掃公園。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher passed the test papers out.

items.audioEn: These shoes were marked down because the box is a little damaged.
items.audioZh: 這雙鞋降價了，因為盒子有一點損壞。
options: The box they come in is not perfect

items.sentenceEn: Don't play down how hard you worked.
items.sentenceZh: 別把你付出的努力說得那麼輕描淡寫。

items.sentenceEn: Good leaders always look ahead to the future.
items.sentenceZh: 好的領導者總是著眼未來。

items.stemEn: Our teacher ____ a lot of effort to help us pass the exam.
items.stemZh: 我們老師投入了很多心力，幫助我們通過考試。

items.stemEn: Customers were angry when the store ____ its prices just before the holiday, so everything cost more.
items.stemZh: 那家店在假期前夕調高價格，東西都變貴了，顧客都很生氣。

items.passageEn: Ella, a high school student, has started to look ahead to her future. With help from her teacher, she made a simple plan and laid it out step by step: finish school, study design at college, and then find work at a fashion company. She knows it won't be easy, so she puts the work in: two hours of drawing practice every evening. When friends praise her pictures, she tends to play down her talent, but her teacher says she has a real gift.
items.passageZh: 高中生 Ella 開始展望自己的未來。在老師的幫忙下，她訂了一個簡單的計畫，並一步步列出來：先完成學業，大學念設計，然後到時尚公司工作。她知道這並不容易，所以下足了功夫：每天晚上都花兩個小時練習畫畫。朋友稱讚她的畫時，她常常輕描淡寫地帶過，但老師說她真的很有天分。

questions.questionZh: 朋友稱讚她的畫時，她通常怎麼做？
options: 低調說自己沒那麼厲害

items.promptZh: 這家店把所有的夏季衣服都降價了。
referenceEn: This shop has marked down all its summer clothes.
The shop marked down all of its summer clothes.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「降價」（例如 marked down all its summer clothes 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 reduced the prices of、cut the prices of、put … on sale 等）
時態可用現在完成式或過去式（例如 has marked down、marked down 等）
「夏季衣服」可寫，例如 summer clothes、summer clothing 等

items.promptZh: 經理淡化了這個錯誤的嚴重性。
referenceEn: The manager played down how serious the mistake was.
The manager has played down how serious the error was.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「淡化」（例如 played down、played it down 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 downplayed、made the mistake seem less serious 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 played down、has played down 等）
「嚴重性」可寫，例如 how serious the mistake was 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「制定（規則）」接近 lay out 的另一個常見意思（lay out the rules／plans＝列出、說明、規劃），且與 glossZh 第二義「規劃」相近，當干擾項不妥。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：lay out 干擾項「制定（規則）」換成「延後」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「傳遞」與 glossZh 第二義「分發」幾乎同義（pass out the papers＝發下／傳下去），當干擾項不妥。
